configurations.name: app
runtimeArgs:
export PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH

# --- Database: copy from main repo if worktree copy is empty/missing ---
MAIN_REPO=$(git worktree list --porcelain | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //')
MAIN_DB="$MAIN_REPO/backend/data/lisboa_realestate.db"
WT_DB="backend/data/lisboa_realestate.db"
mkdir -p backend/data
if [ -f "$MAIN_DB" ]; then
  MAIN_SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$MAIN_DB" 2>/dev/null || stat -c%s "$MAIN_DB" 2>/dev/null)
  WT_SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$WT_DB" 2>/dev/null || stat -c%s "$WT_DB" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$WT_SIZE" -lt 500000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f "$WT_DB" "${WT_DB}-shm" "${WT_DB}-wal"
    cp "$MAIN_DB" "$WT_DB"
    echo "[launch] Copied DB from main repo (${MAIN_SIZE} bytes)"
  fi
fi

# --- Backend: find a free port and start ---
BACKEND_PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')
PORT=$BACKEND_PORT python3 backend/api.py &
BACKEND_PID=$!
trap "kill $BACKEND_PID 2>/dev/null" EXIT

# Wait for backend to be ready (up to 15s)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -s http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT/api/stats >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 0.5
done
echo "[launch] Backend ready on port $BACKEND_PORT"

# --- Frontend: start Vite with proxy pointing to backend ---
cd frontend
[ -d node_modules ] || npm install
BACKEND_PORT=$BACKEND_PORT npx vite --port ${PORT:-3000}
